title: Inline Variable

solutions.title: Only the variables that earn their line
solutions.tradeoff: Some expressions get longer, and three variables survive for reasons that have nothing to do with their names - which means the rule you leave with is a judgement, not a lint rule.

reviewFocus: Every variable that survived: can you say in one sentence what it earns? Three should survive, for three different reasons.
Did any inline duplicate an expression? Inline Variable that buys Duplicated Code is a bad trade, and it is the easiest mistake to make here.
Is `average` still computed outside the callback? Inlining it is textually one substitution and turns one division into n.
Is the first segment still measured from the start line and not from the previous mat? `previous` is `undefined` there, and the `?? 0` is load-bearing.
Count the lines removed. If the file did not get shorter, the variables you removed were not the aliasing ones.
